text: Prior root-cause evidence identified native-archive heap exhaustion, not the suspected modal dialog. Landed build guards provide explicit fork heaps, ExitOnOutOfMemoryError, and sequential fresh JVMs for large native journeys, preventing a poisoned or timed-out native process from contaminating later FX suites. This tranche caches repeated result-reference parsing and synchronizes theme/preset assertions with completed reads/writes. Close only once the landed main Studio workflow succeeds on both Linux and macOS; broader archive-memory optimization remains open. Acceptance completed on landed PR #4 commit 57806b8b68dd85b9f4b5002a79110c7a15db9d6a, tree cbde1627427bd87084b6ba681436576baf735ec7. Full canonical landing gate and strict headless Studio gate passed. All main workflows now pass: Studio https://github.com/canardlapin/eyes4s/actions/runs/38356698055 (Linux headless, macOS functional, clean-clone pins), Checks https://github.com/canardlapin/eyes4s/actions/runs/38356698061, Security and Clean. Current dependencies were rechecked as closed before this closure. The remaining archive-memory optimization is outside this bounded tranche.
